site: Example uav1 velocity bench (operator overlay example, not a flight approval)
notes: Example numeric envelopes only. The pinned controller YAML states a combined velocity max_xy of 10.0 m/s, a velocity z maximum of 5.0 m/s and an attitude yawrate maximum of 3.14; it states no per-axis x or y bound, so all four inputs are operator_required and this overlay must supply them. These values are operator choices, not device facts, not a flight envelope and not a recommendation. A real site must replace them with its own assessed limits.

linear_x.reason: example site envelope for base_stabilized velocity x

linear_y.reason: example site envelope for base_stabilized velocity y

linear_z.reason: example site envelope for vertical velocity

angular_z.reason: example site envelope for yaw rate
